blocks.text: Joshua Pacio retained his ONE strawweight MMA world title with a fourth-round submission of Japanese challenger Keito Yamakita in the main event of ONE Samurai 5 on Wednesday in Tokyo. The Filipino fighter finished Yamakita with an arm-triangle choke after surviving an early grappling assault from the Japanese challenger at Ebara Wave Arena Ota. READ: Joshua Pacio targets two-division glory in ONE Championship Yamakita used his wrestling to secure multiple takedowns in the opening round and nearly submitted the Filipino with an inverted triangle.
